notes.title: Meat Engine: Plans for the next few updates
notes.content:
This post is going to mainly outline the next few updates and planned content. Note that not all features listed in this post will be coming in the next few updates. This serves as more of a roadmap for what's coming.

A two new developers are joining the team Zelfmonco as lead programmer and DVAT as lead sound designer. 

Also just a heads up, these features are going to take a long time to develop. The sound will likely take the longest. Most of these changes are just to enhance the existing experience and further polish the game.

New and planned content that's in the works. 

- An overhaul the to player movement for smoother and more consistent gameplay. Along with 
  some other soft overhauls to various systems within the games. 

- Enemies are getting some more changes and are going to be reprogrammed to be more fair and 
   less buggy.

- Updates to the player save system to improve its consistency

- A new level select screen with a visual map

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129183/2cc6d0ba298c340bac5cc0925a4ef688c496cade.png

- Overhauling all the sounds in the game along with the ambience within levels. The focus of this is 
   to unify the audio quality and make sure sounds have better audio spacing

- FMOD is going to be used from now on to provide a far better audio experience in game

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129183/e5a26e0475b07217c1d6217f444cef08c890a08b.png

- Environmental story telling is being added to the existing levels to help give them more character 
   and story

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129183/fa641b3a9be45912284635ed4a18e2afb746c20a.png

- A new invincibility system for the player to avoid instances where the player dies to fast.

notes.title: New Meat Engine update coming soon
notes.content:
A new Meat Engine update is coming this month celebrating 1 year of updates to the demo version of the game. 

This update will include some new content and changes to enemies and some of the levels. I've also got some bug fixes with the menus and some of the sliding interactions.
A new dialog system will be added with some new NPCs you can talk to if you wish to know more about the story. 

Thank you so much to everyone who has played the demo so far!

notes.title: Meat Engine Demo Coming soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129183/50ce9a75bdce670ec4addb72ca0c502638b819d0.png


Good news, the Meat Engine demo will be released on steam soon!

The demo will include 2 levels, 4 weapons and 3 enemy types. With future updates adding more content.

Its been a long journey getting the demo ready for steam. I want to say a special thanks to the Unreal Slackers/Unreal Source Discord. With out their feedback and support I would have never gotten the confidence to release this demo. This game still has a long way to go and I look forward to seeing how the game evolves based on feedback.

I look forward to hearing the community's feedback!
